entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 21 | Baptizata e[st] Theresia filia Christiani Esler, et Elisabethae Conjugis, Levans Elisabetha Folqnerin, Testes Petrus Scholtz, Georgius Heinrich, Catharina Schrollerin, Maria Beierin, de Petrovicio.
entries.notes: Na s085_right (pag. 158) zápis o nástupu faráře P. Kiliána Ferdinanda Zachera 22. 6. 1728 a změna písařské ruky; od s085_right po s086_right bez petrovických křtů.

entries.subject: Anna Maria Theresia
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Anna Maria Scholtzin; Testes Anna Maria Hermanin, Susanna Steinerin, Christoph Oepel, Georg Adam Exner ex Rothflößl
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | Dito [5.] | Baptizata est Anna Maria Theresia filia Antonij Francisci Ruprecht et Catharinae Conjugis ejus. Levans Anna Maria Scholtzin Testes Anna Maria Hermanin et Susanna Steinerin et Christoph Oepel et Georg Adam Exner. omnes Petrovicio [pod řádkem: excepto ultimo ex Rothflösse].
entries.notes: Antonius Franciscus Ruprecht později uváděn jako petrovický učitel / kantor (ludimagister / cantor). Poslední svědek Georg Adam Exner výslovně z Červeného Potoka ('excepto ultimo ex Rothflösse').

entries.subject: Birgitta Anna
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Maria Hermanin; Testes Catharina Kytnerin, Christophorus Wagner
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | d. 8. | Baptizata est Birgitta Anna filia Caspari Wagner et Rosinae Conjugis ejus. Levans Maria Hermanin. Testes Catharina Kytnerin et Christophorus Wagner omnes Petrovicio.

entries.subject: Anna Barbara
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Maria Hofmanin; Testes Regina Wagnerin, Christianus Herman
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 26. | Baptizata est Anna Barbara filia Zachariae Schroller et Annae Conjugis ejus. Levans Maria Hofmanin. Testes Regina Wagnerin et Christianus Herman omnes Petrovic.

entries.subject: Joannes Georgius
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Joannes Steiner; Testes Christophorus Wagner, Brigitta Adlerin
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | Dito 1. | Baptizatus est Joannes Georgius filius Friderici Reynelt, et Mariae Conjugis ejus. Levans Joannes Steiner. Testes Christophorus Wagner, et Brigitta Adlerin omnes Petrovicio.

entries.subject: Joannes Christophorus
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Joannes Bayer; Testes Christianus Lux, Catharina Schinin
entries.transcription: Petrovicio. | Dito [15] | Baptizatus est Joannes Christophorus filius Josephi Schroller et Mariae Conjugis ejus. Levans Joannes Bayer. Testes Christianus Lux et Catharina Schinin omnes Petrovicio.

entries.subject: Agnes Magdalena
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Rosina Conjux Caspari Wagnerin; Testes Anna Maria Conjux Kristiani Wagneriana, Georg Adam Exner (Rothflößlâ)
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 26. | Baptizata est Agnes Magdalena filia Josephi Scholtz [nad řádkem: Teloniarij] et Susannae Conjugis ejus. Levans Rosina [nad řádkem: Conjux Caspari] Wagnerin. Testes Anna Maria Conjux [nad řádkem: Kristiani] Wagneriana et Georg Adam Exner ultimus Rothflößlâ. reliq. Petrovicio.
entries.notes: Výslovně doloženo povolání otce: 'Teloniarij' (celník / výběrčí mýta) dopsané nad 'Scholtz'.

entries.subject: Joannes Casparus
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Petrus Folkner; Testes Caspar Pacha, Anna Maria uxor Laurentij Schltz(?) [Scholz?]
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 6. | Baptizatus est Joannes Casparus filius Josephi [nad řádkem: Pistoris] Scholtz et Veronicae Conjugis ejus. Levans Petrus Folkner Testes Caspar Pacha et Anna Maria uxor Laurentij [škrtnuto: Got...] Schltz(?) [Scholz?] omnes Petrovicio [pod řádkem: except. ult. q(ui/ae) Rothflößel baptizavit A R D. Melchior Latzel Curat. Wixstad.]
entries.notes: Povolání otce 'Pistoris' (pekař) vloženo nad 'Josephi', čímž se odlišuje od celníka Josepha Scholtze i mlynáře Josepha Scholtze. Křtil mladkovský kurát Melchior Latzel.

entries.subject: Anna Maria Theresia
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Maria Conjux Christiani Herman; Testes Petrus Folkner, Christianus Wagner
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 9. | Baptizata est Anna Maria Theresia filia Martini Schien et Catharinae Conjugis ejus. Levans Maria Conjux Christiani Herman. Testes Petrus Folkner et Christianus Wagner omnes Petrovicio

entries.subject: Joannes Georgius
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Petrus Scholtz; Testes Ferdinandus Lux, Catharina Schienin
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 29. | Baptizatus est Joannes Georgius filius Caspari Adler, et Susannae conjugis ejus. Levans Petrus Scholtz. Testes Ferdinandus Lux et Catharina Schienin omnes Petrovicio.

entries.subject: Joannes
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Joannes Kytner; Testes Joannes Urba, Maria filia Christophori Esler
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 10. | Baptizatus est Joannes filius Georgij Hofman et Clarae Conjugis ejus. Levans Joannes Kytner. Testes Joannes Urba et Maria filia Christophori Esler omnes Petrovicio.

entries.subject: Anna Susanna
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Susanna Conjux Joannis Steiner; Testes Elisabeth Luxin [škrtnuto: Frid. Conjux], Caspar Adler
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | Dito [3] | Baptizata est Anna Susanna filia Joannis Herman et Catharinae Conjugis ejus. Levans Susanna Conjux Joannis Steiner Testes Elisabeth Luxin [škrtnuto: Frid. Conjux] et Caspar Adler

entries.subject: Anna Elisabetha
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Catharina Kytnerin; Testes Elisabetha Conjux Christiani Lux, Joannes Pacha
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 6. | Baptizata est Anna Elisabetha filia Christiani Wagner, et Mariae conjugis ejus. Levans Catharina Kytnerin Testes Elisabetha Conjux Christiani Lux, et Joannes Pacha omnes Petrovicio.

entries.subject: Anna Rosina
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Anna Maria uxor Petri Scholtz; Testes Catharina Christophori Wagner Conjux, Andreas Albel (Teuto Petersdorff)
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 11. | Baptizata est Anna Rosina filia Jeremiae Langer et Annae Conjugis ejus. Levans Anna Maria uxor Petri Scholtz. Testes Catharina Christophori Wagner Conjux, et Andreas Albel hic ex Teuto Petersdorff. reliq. ex Boëm Petrovic.
entries.notes: Přímé odlišení obou obcí v jednom zápisu: svědek Andreas Albel 'ex Teuto Petersdorff' (Petrovičky), ostatní 'ex Boëm Petrovic' (České Petrovice).

entries.subject: Antonius
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Laurentius Langer; Testes Casparus Pacha, Rosina Conjux Antonij Payer
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 4. | Baptizatus est Antonius filius Henrici Wagner et Susannae Conjugis ejus. Levans Laurentius Langer. Testes Casparus Pacha et Rosina Conjux Antonij Payer omnes Petrovicio

entries.subject: Josephus
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Michaël Hofman; Testes Christophorus Wagner, Susanna Conjux Joannis Steiner
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 5! [přepsáno přes 4] | Baptizatus est Josephus filius Philippi Herman et Mariae Conjugis ejus. Levans Michaël Hofman Testes Christophorus Wagner et Susanna Conjux Joannis Steiner omnes Petrovicio.
entries.notes: Den zapsán jako 5 opravený přes 4 (následující zápis je 6. května).

entries.subject: Antonius Michaël
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Caspar Schmok; Testes Martinus Schön, Barbara Conjux Georgij Schmok
entries.transcription: Petrovicio. | 8. | Baptizatus est Antonius Michaël filius Christiani Esler, et Reginae Conjugis ejus. Levans Caspar Schmok. Testes Martinus Schön et Barbara Conjux Georgij Schmok, oes Petrovicio.

entries.subject: Anna Maria
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Susanna uxor Joannis Steiner; Testes Catharina Conjux Salomonis Schön, Casparus Wagner
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 3 | Baptizata est Anna Maria filia Josephi Weber et Elisabethae Conjugis ejus. Levans Susanna uxor Joannis Steiner. Testes Catharina Conjux Salomonis Schön et Casparus Wagner omnes Petrovicio.

entries.subject: Joannes
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Christophorus Epel; Testes Petrus Folkner, Anna uxor Zachariae Schroller
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 11. | Baptizatus est Joannes filius Christophori Urba et Elisabethae Conjugis ejus. Levans Christophorus Epel. Testes Petrus Folkner et Anna uxor Zachariae Schroller omnes Petrovicio.

entries.subject: Joannes Kilianus
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Joannes Georgius Steiner; Testes Georgius Hofman, Anna Maria uxor Christiani Herman
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 22. | Baptizatus est Joannes Kilianus filius Josephi Wagner et Mariae Conjugis ejus. Levans Joannes Georgius Steiner. Testes Georgius Hofman et Anna Maria uxor Christiani Herman omnes Petrovicio.

entries.subject: Ignatius Joannes Josephus
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Georgius Adamus Echsner ex Rothflösl; Testes Casparus Pacha, Maria uxor Christiani Herman
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 23. | Baptizatus est Ignatius Joannes Josephus filius Laurentij Langer et Mariae Conjugis ejus. Levans Georgius Adamus Echsner ex Rothflösl, Testes Casparus Pacha et Maria uxor Christiani Herman hi reliq. oes Petrovicio.

entries.subject: Maria Magdalena
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Rosina uxor Caspari Wagner; Testes Regina Conjux Christiani Reynelt Welsdorffio, Casparus Wagner junior
entries.transcription: Petrovicio. | 1. | Baptizata est Maria Magdalena filia [škrtnuto: Caspari Wagner] Friderici Kytner et Catharinae Conjugis ejus. Levans Rosina uxor Caspari Wagner. Testes Regina Conjux Christiani Reynelt Welsdorffio et Casparus Wagner junior reliq. omnes Petrovicio.
entries.notes: Písař škrtl omylem zapsaného otce 'Caspari Wagner' a dopsal 'Friderici Kytner'.

entries.subject: Antonius
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Josephus Scholtz jun.(?); Testes Philippus Herman, Anna Schrollerin
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 2 | Baptizatus est Antonius filius Josephi Kytner et Rosinae Conjugis ejus. Levans Josephus Scholtz [nad řádkem: jun:(?)]. Testes Philippus Herman et Anna Schrollerin omnes Petrovicio.
entries.notes: Nad kmotrem Josefem Scholtzem vloženo rozlišující 'jun:' (junior?).

entries.subject: Anna Maria
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Rosalia filia Georgij Henrich; Testes Rosina uxor Caspari Wagner, Rosina Hermanin, Christianus Herman
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 10. | Baptizata est [škrtnuto: Joseph] Anna Maria filia Josephi Schmok et Annae Conjugis ejus. Levans Rosalia filia Georgij Henrich. Testes Rosina uxor Caspari Wagner et Rosina Hermanin et Christianus Herman oes Petrovicio.

entries.subject: Casparus
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Joannes Georg. Langer; Testes Georgius Henrich, Susanna Adlerin
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 21. | Baptizatus est Casparus filius Josephi Lux et Apolloniae Conjugis ejus. Levans Joannes Georg. Langer. Testes Georgius Henrich et Susanna Adlerin omnes Petrovicio.

entries.subject: Joannes Christophorus
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Joannes Steiner; Testes Casparus Pacha, Maria Conjux Christiani Herman
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 8. | Baptizatus est Joannes Christophorus filius Christophori Epel et Mariae Conjugis ejus. Levans Joannes Steiner Testes Casparus Pacha et Maria Conjux Christiani Herman oes Petrovicio.
entries.notes: Zapsáno před 12. září po položce z 9. září.

entries.subject: Brigitta
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Catharina conjux Martini Schön; Testes Georgius Hoffman, Christianus Herman, Susanna conjux Caspari Pacha, Catharina Conjux Friderici Kyttner
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 23 | Baptizata est [škrtnuto: Susanna; nad řádkem: Brigitta] filia Christiani Lux et Susannae Conjugis ejus. Levans Catharina conjux Martini Schön. Testes Georgius Hoffman et Christianus Herman et Susanna conjux Caspari Pacha et Catharina Conjux Friderici Kyttner Baptiz. A R D. Melch. Latzel Wixst.
entries.notes: Jméno dítěte opraveno ze škrtnutého 'Susanna' na nadřádkové 'Brigitta'.

entries.subject: Michaël
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Christianus Herman; Testes Birgitta conjux Josephi Schroller, Catharina Friderici Kyttner uxor
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | Dito [29.] | Baptizatus est Michaël filius Christiani Steiner et Birgittae conjugis ejus. Levans Christianus Herman Testes Birgitta conjux Josephi Schroller et Catharina Friderici Kyttner uxor.

entries.subject: Joannes Christophorus Lucas
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Joannes Christophorus Langer; Testes Petrus Folkner, Elisabetha conjux Ferdinandi Lux
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 18 | Baptizatus est Joannes Christophorus Lucas filius Christophori Esler et Rosinae Conjugis ejus. Levans Joannes Christophorus Langer Testes Petrus Folkner et Elisabetha conjux Ferdinandi Lux, omnes Petrovicio.
entries.notes: Zapsáno na řádku mezi 21. 10. a 26. 10.

entries.subject: Joanna Catharina
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Maria conjux Christophori Epel; Testes Maria conjux Christiani Herman, Georg Adam Echsner von Rothflößl
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 13. | Baptizata est Joanna Catharina filia Antonij Ruprecht et Catharinae Conjugis ejus. Levans Maria conjux Christophori Epel. Testes Maria conjux Christiani Herman hi oes Petrovicio et Georg Adam Echsner von Rothflößl
entries.notes: Hned v následujícím nekořském zápisu z téhož dne (13. 11. 1729) figurují jako kmotři 'Josephus Scholz et Regina Conjux Christophi Wagner senioris Cantoris oēs Petrovicio'.

entries.subject: Anna Barbara
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Elisabetha Conjux Ferdinandi Lux; Testis Joannes Pacha
entries.transcription: Petrovicio. | 28 | Baptizata est Anna Barbara filia Friderici Epel et Susannae Conjugis ejus. Levans Elisabetha Conjux Ferdinandi Lux et Joannes Pacha omnes Petrovicio.

entries.subject: Joannes Michaël
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Theresia Conjux Josephi Scholtz; Testes Anna Maria filia Andreae Lux, Caspar Wagner
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 8. | Baptizatus est Joannes Michaël filius Antonij Beyer et Annae Mariae Conjugis ejus. Levans Theresia Conjux Josephi Scholtz Testes Anna Maria filia Andreae Lux et Caspar Wagner omnes Petrovicio.

entries.subject: Joannes Michaël
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Josephus Scholtz Molitor; Testes Petrus Folkner, Elisabetha uxor Christiani Lux
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 20. | Baptizatus est Joannes Michaël filius Joannis Wagner et Reginae Conjugis ejus. Levans Josephus Scholtz Molitor. Testes Petrus Folkner, et Elisabetha uxor Christiani Lux omnes Petrovicio.
entries.notes: Hlavní kmotr uveden jako mlynář: 'Josephus Scholtz Molitor'.

entries.subject: Joannes Josephus
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Antonius Lux; Testes Joannes Hofman, Anna Conjux Zachariae Schroller
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 2. | Baptizatus est Joannes Josephus filius Joannis Georgij Nahlik et Annae Mariae Conjugis ejus. Levans Antonius Lux. Testes Joannes Hofman et Anna Conjux Zachariae Schroller omnes Petrovicio.
entries.notes: Pod záhlavím 'Annus Domini 1730 Mense Januario'; číslice dne ověřena v kontrastním kvadrantu jako '2.'.

entries.subject: Ignatius
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Georgius Hofman; Testes Christianus Lux, Anna Maria Conjux Petri Scholtz
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 6. | Baptizatus est Ignatius filius Joannis Steiner et Susannae Conjugis ejus. Levans Georgius Hofman. Testes Christianus Lux et Anna Maria Conjux Petri Scholtz. omnes Petrovicio. Baptizavit A.R.D. Andr. Beschorner Curat. Wixst.
entries.notes: Křtil mladkovský kurát P. Andreas Beschorner.

entries.subject: Theresia
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Maria Conjux Joannis Kyttner (Testes nulli alii propter properare et nimium periculum)
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 9. | Baptizata est Theresia filia Christiani Lux et Elisabethae Co[n]jugis ejus. Levans Maria Conjux Joannis Kyttner. Testes nulli alij propter properare et nimium periculum. Baptizavit A R D. Andr. Beschorner Curat. Wixst.
entries.notes: Křest v nebezpečí smrti bez dalších svědků ('propter properare et nimium periculum'). Na témže snímku vpravo nahoře (7. 4. Linsdorffio) svědek 'Joannes Georgius Katzer ex Germanico Petrovicio' — vyloučeno jako Petrovičky.

entries.subject: Petrus
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Christianus Herman; Testes Christophorus Esler, Susanna Conjux Joannis Steiner
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 28 | Baptizatus est Petrus filius Petri Scholtz et Mariae Conjugis ejus. Levans Christianus Herman. Testes Christophorus Esler, et Susanna Conjux Joannis Steiner omnes Petrovicio Baptizavit A R D. Beschorner Curat. Wixstad.

entries.subject: Antonius
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans (et baptizans) Maria Conjux Georgij Heinrich
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 29. | Baptizatus est ab obstetrice in su[m]mo periculo mortis, in quo et mortuus est, Antonius filius Christiani Schroller et Mariae Conjugis ejus. Levans Maria Conjux Georgij Heinrich, haec Baptizans et Levans fuit.
entries.notes: Křest z nouze provedený porodní bábou v nejvyšším nebezpečí smrti, v němž dítě také zemřelo ('in quo et mortuus est').

entries.subject: Antonius Sigismundus
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Casparus Wagner; Testes Petrus Folkner, Susanna Conjux Joannis Steiner
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 2. | Baptizatus est Antonius Sigismundus filius Christophori Esler et Mariae Conjugis ejus. Levans Casparus Wagner Testes Petrus Folkner et Susanna Conjux Joannis Steiner omnes Petrovicio.

entries.subject: Antonius
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Petrus Folkner; Testes Christophorus Wagner, Catharina Conjux Friderici Kyttner
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 8. | Baptizatus est Antonius filius Godefridi Wagner, Elisabethaeq[ue] Conjugis ejus. Levans Petrus Folkner. Testes Christophorus Wagner, et Catharina Conjux Friderici Kyttner omnes hi incolae sunt Petrovicenses.

entries.subject: Antonius
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Christianus Herman; Testes Andreas Buchtel Klastercio, Maria Conjux Christiani Lux
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 22 | Baptizatus est Antonius filius Josephi Scholz [nad řádkem: sen. hujus(?)] inferioris(?) Molitoris et Theresiae Conjugis ejus. Levans Christianus Herman Testes Andreas Buchtel et Maria Conjux Christiani Lux omnes Petrovicio excepto Buchtel Klastercio.
entries.notes: Otec uveden jako starší dolní mlynář ('sen. hujus(?) inferioris Molitoris').

entries.subject: Anna Maria
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Maria Conjux Joannis Kyttner; Testes Maria Conjux Christophori Lux, Joannes Urban
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 6 | Baptizata est Anna Maria filia Georgij Hofman et Annae Mariae Conjugis ejus. Levans Maria Conjux Joannis Kyttner. Testes. Maria Conjux Christophori Lux et Joannes Urban omnes Petrovicio.

entries.subject: Anna Theresia
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Anna Maria Conjux Christophori Epel; Testes Elisabetha Conjux Ferdinandi Lux, Petrus Scholtz
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 20. | Baptizata est Anna Theresia filia Antonij Lux et Elisabethae Conjugis ejus. Levans Anna Maria Conjux Christophori Epel. Testes Elisabetha Conjux Ferdinandi Lux et Petrus Scholtz omnes Petrovicio.

entries.subject: Kilianus Antonius
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Georg Adam Exner ex Rotflösl; Testes Petrus Scholtz, Maria conjux Christophori Epel
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 20. | Baptizatus est Kilianus Antonius filius Antonij Ruprecht ludimag. Boëmo-Petrovicensis et Mariae Catharinae Conjugis ejus. Levans Georg Adam Exner ex Rotflösl. Testes Petrus Scholtz et Maria conjux Christophori Epel hi reliq. omnes Petrovicio.
entries.notes: Výslovně uvedeno povolání otce: 'ludimag. Boëmo-Petrovicensis' (českopetrovický učitel / správce školy).

entries.subject: Anna Maria
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Anna Maria Conjux Petri Scholtz; Testes Susanna Conjux Joannis Steiner, Christianus Herman
entries.transcription: Petrovicio [dole: NB. pro oblivionem serius posita] | d. 23 7bris | Baptizata est Anna Maria filia Joannis Peyer et Annae Mariae Conjugis ejus. Levans Anna Maria Conjux Petri Scholtz Testes Susanna Conjux Joannis Steiner et Christianus Herman oes Petrovicio.
entries.notes: Zápis z 23. 9. 1730 opomenutý v září a dodatečně vepsaný po 16. 10. 1730 s marginální poznámkou 'NB. pro oblivionem serius posita'.

entries.subject: Antonius
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Fridericus Kyttner; Testes Maria Conjux Christiani Herman, Maria Conjux Christophori Wagner
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 20. oct. | Baptizatus est Antonius filius Caspari Wagner et Rosinae Conjugis ejus. Levans [škrtnuto: Caspar] Fridericus Kyttner Testes Maria Conjux Christiani Herman et Maria Conjux Christophori Wagner omnes Petrovicio.

entries.subject: Anna Catharina
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Susanna Conjux Caspari Adler; Testes Susanna Conjux Joannis Steiner, Ferdinandus Lux
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 22. | Baptizata est Anna Catharina filia Joannis Herman et Catharinae Conjugis ejus. Levans Susanna Conjux Caspari Adler. Testes Susanna Conjux Joannis Steiner et Ferdinandus Lux omnes Petrovicio.

entries.subject: Antonius
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Christophorus Epel; Testes Casparus Pacha, Anna Conjux Zachariae Schroller
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 23. | Baptizatus est Antonius filius Henrici Reynelt et Mariae Conjugis ejus. Levans Christophorus Epel Testes Casparus Pacha et Anna Conjux Zachariae Schroller omnes Petrovicio.

entries.subject: Joannes Christophorus
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Christophorus Epel; Testes Antonius Sauer Gihakio(?) [Čihakio?], Clara Conjux Georgij Hofman
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 12 | Baptizatus est Joannes Christophorus filius Christophori Reynelt et Mariae Conjugis ejus. Levans Christophorus Epel. Testes Antonius Sauer Gihakio(?) [Čihakio?] et Clara Conjux Georgij Hofman sc. caeteri Petrovicio.
entries.notes: Svědek Antonius Sauer ze sousedního Čiháku ('Gihakio(?)' / 'Čihakio', srov. s106_right 'Gšhakio').

entries.subject: Joannes Josephus
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Petrus Scholtz; Testes Maria Conjux Caspari Pacha, Maria Conjux Christiani Wagner
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 27. | Baptizatus est Joannes Josephus filius Andreae Urba et Barbarae Conjugis ejus. Levans Petrus Scholtz. Testes Maria Conjux Caspari Pacha et Maria Conjux Christiani Wagner omnes Petrovicio.

entries.subject: Ferdinandus
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Casparus Adler; Testes Joannes Steiner, Elisabetha Conjux Christophori Esler
entries.transcription: Petrovicio [dole: serò insinuat.] | 18 | Baptizatus est Ferdinandus filius Joannis Postler et Mariae Conjugis ejus. Levans Casparus Adler. Testes Joannes Steiner et Elisabetha Conjux Christophori Esler omnes Petrovicio.
entries.notes: Zápis zařazen pod 28. listopadem a před nadpisem 'Mense Decembri' s marginální poznámkou 'serò insinuat.' (pozdě nahlášeno), tedy křest z 18. 11. 1730.

entries.subject: Maria Emerentiana
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Susanna vidua superst. post def. Christophorum Esler; Testes Ferdinandus Lux, Clara Conjux Georgij Hofman
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | Dito [23.] | Baptizata est Maria Emerentiana filia Joannis Urba et Mariae Conjugis ejus. Levans Susanna vidua superst. post def. Christophorum Esler Testes Ferdinandus Lux et Clara Conjux Georgij Hofman omnes Petrovicio.

entries.subject: Birgitta
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Elisabetha Conjux Antonij Lux; Testes Susanna vidua superstes post def. Christophorum Herman, Christophorus Epel
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 21. | Baptizata est Birgitta filia Ferdinandi Lux et Elisabethae Conjugis ejus. Levans Elisabetha Conjux Antonij Lux. Testes Susanna vidua superstes post def. Christophorum Herman et Christophorus Epel omnes Petrovicio.

entries.subject: Antonius
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Christianus Wagner; Testes Christophorus Wagner, Maria Conjux Christiani Herman
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 27. | Baptizatus est Antonius filius Martini Schön et Catharinae Conjugis ejus. Levans Christianus Wagner. Testes Christophorus Wagner et Maria Conjux Christiani Herman omnes Petrovicio.

entries.subject: Barbara
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Maria Conjux Christiani Lux; Testes Catharina Conjux Salomonis Schön, Joannes Payer
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 14. | Baptizata est Barbara filia Josephi Schroller et Annae Mariae Conjugis ejus. Levans Maria Conjux Christiani Lux. Testes Catharina Conjux Salomonis Schön et Joannes Payer omnes Petrovicio.

entries.subject: Maria Magdalena
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Birgitta superstes filia post def. Mathiam Adler; Testes Anna Maria Conjux Georgij Hofman, Joannes Steiner
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 10. | Baptizata est Maria Magdalena filia Friderici Reynelt et Mariae Conjugis ejus. Levans Birgitta superstes filia post def. Mathiam Adler. Testes Anna Maria Conjux Georgij Hofman, et Joannes Steiner, omnes Petrovicio. Baptizavit Wixstad. D. Curatus
entries.notes: V datovém sloupci zřetelně napsáno '10.', zápis je však zařazen mezi 19. 4. a 23. 4. (zřejmě písařská chyba za 20. 4. 1731).

entries.subject: Anna
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Maria Conjux Georgij Hofman; Testes Regina Conjux Christophori Wagner, Christianus Herman
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 27. | Baptizata est Anna filia Zachariae Schroller et Annae Conjugis ejus. Levans Maria Conjux Georgij Hofman. Testes Regina Conjux Christophori Wagner et Christianus Herman omnes Petrovicio.

entries.subject: Anna Veronica
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Maria Conjux Christiani Wagner; Testes Maria Conjux Joannis Kyttner, Christophorus Epel
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 29. | Baptizata est Anna Veronica filia Christiani Lux et Elisabethae Conjugis ejus. Levans Maria Conjux Christiani Wagner. Testes Maria Conjux Joannis Kyttner et Christophorus Epel omnes Petrovicio.

entries.subject: Antonius
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Christophorus Esler; Testes Salomon Schön, Susanna filia superstes post def. Georgium Schreiber Steinbacio
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 4. | Baptizatus est Antonius filius Adami Lux et Annae Conjugis ejus. Levans Christophorus Esler. Testes Salomon Schön et Susanna filia superstes post def. Georgium Schreiber Steinbacio reliq. Petrovicio.
entries.notes: Svědkyně Susanna Schreiberová z Kameničné ('Steinbacio').

entries.subject: Joannes Fridericus
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Josephus Wagner; Testes Georgius Schmok, Elisabetha Conjux Petri Folkner
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 18. | Baptizatus est Joannes Fridericus filius Christiani Lux et Susannae Conjugis ejus. Levans Josephus Wagner. Testes Georgius Schmok et Elisabetha Conjux Petri Folkner omnes Petrovicio.

entries.subject: Antonius
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Josephus Schroller; Testes Antonius Lux, Elisabetha Petri Folkner Conjux
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 30. | Baptizatus est Antonius filius Josephi Epel et Caeciliae Conjugis ejus. Levans Josephus Schroller. Testes Antonius Lux et Elisabetha Petri Folkner Conjux omnes Petrovicio.

entries.subject: Joannes Josephus
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Josephus Lux; Testes Joannes Urba, Birgitta Conjux Josephi Schroller
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 5. | Baptizatus est Joannes Josephus filius Josephi Peschke et Mariae Conjugis ejus. Levans Josephus Lux. Testes Joannes Urba et Birgitta Conjux Josephi Schroller omnes Petrovicio

entries.subject: Barbara
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Maria Conjux Christiani Herman; Testes Maria Conjux Georgij Hofman, Adamus Georgius Exner (Rothflößl), Joannes Steiner
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 17. | Baptizata est Barbara filia Josephi Wagner et Mariae Conjugis ejus Levans Maria Conjux Christiani Herman Testes Maria Conjux Georgij Hofman et Adamus Georgius Exner, Joannes Steiner omnes Petrovicio excepto Exner qui ex Rothflößl.

entries.subject: Birgitta
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Elisabetha filia Joannis Herman defuncti; Testes Maria Conjux Christiani Lux, Christophorus Epel
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 16. | Baptizata est Birgitta filia Josephi Esler et Mariae Conjugis ejus. Levans Elisabetha [škrtnuto: Conj.] filia Joannis Herman defuncti. Testes Maria Conjux Christiani Lux et [škrtnuto: Josephus] Christophorus Epel omnes Petrovicio.

entries.subject: Joannes Josephus
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Joannes Josephus filius Georgij Heinrich; Testes Petrus Scholtz, Maria filia Caspari Schroller
entries.transcription: Batzdorffio transeunter Mat. Petrovicij origa | 24. | Baptizatus est Joannes Josephus filius Georgij Hirschberger et Annae Mariae Conjugis ejus. Levans Joannes Josephus filius Georgij Heinrich Testes Petrus Scholtz et Maria filia Caspari Schroller omnes Petrovicii.
entries.notes: Dítě průchozích rodičů z Bartošovic ('Batzdorffio transeunter'), matka rodem z Českých Petrovic ('Mat. Petrovicij origa'), všichni kmotři z Petrovic.

entries.subject: Antonius
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Antonius Ruprecht p.t. Cantor Petrovic.; Testes Casparus Pacha, Antonius Lux
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 28. | Baptizatus est Antonius filius Caspari Schmok et Magdalenae Conjugis ejus. Levans Antonius Ruprecht p.t. Cantor Petrovic. Testes [škrtnuto: Christiana] Casparus Pacha, et Antonius Lux omnes reliq Petrovicio.
entries.notes: Hlavní kmotr Antonius Ruprecht zde výslovně titulován 'p.t. Cantor Petrovic.' (pro tempore petrovický kantor).

entries.subject: Theresia Lucia
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Maria Conjux Christiani Herman; Testes Maria Conjux Joannis Payer, Joannes Steiner, Salomon Schön
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 13. | Baptizata est Theresia Lucia filia Petri Scholtz et Annae Mariae Conjugis ejus. Levans Maria Conjux Christiani Herman. Testes Maria Conjux Joannis Payer et Joannes Steiner et Salomon Schön omnes Petrovicio.

entries.subject: Anna Elisabetha
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Maria Conjux Michaëlis Hoffman; Testes Catharina Conjux Salomonis Schön, Joannes Steiner
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 20. | Baptizata est Anna Elisabetha filia Philippi Herman et Mariae Conjugis ejus. Levans Maria Conjux Michaëlis Hoffman. Testes Catharina Conjux Salomonis Schön et Joannes Steiner omnes Petrovicio.

entries.subject: Antonius Josephus
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Christianus Herman; Testes Martinus Schön, Elisabetha Conjux Petri Folkner
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 17. | Baptizatus est Antonius Josephus filius Josephi Scholtz Pistoris et Veronicae Conjugis ejus. Levans Christianus Herman. Testes Martinus Schön, et Elisabetha Conjux Petri Folkner, omnes Petrovicio. Baptizavit A R D. Beschorner Curat. Wixst.
entries.notes: Povolání otce 'Pistoris' (pekař). Zapsáno těsně po křtu z 20. 1. 1732.

entries.subject: Birgitta
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Susanna Conjux Joannis Steiner; Testes Susanna Conjux Caspari Pacha, Christianus Herman
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 29. | Baptizata est Birgitta filia Christophori Epel et Annae Mariae Conjugis ejus. Levans Susanna Conjux Joannis Steiner Testes Susanna Conjux Caspari Pacha et Christianus Herman omnes Petrovicio.
entries.notes: Přestupný rok 1732 (29. únor).

entries.subject: Theresia
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Maria Conjux Christiani Wagner; Testes Susanna Conjux Caspari Pacha, Petrus Scholtz judex
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 9. | Baptizata est Theresia filia Andreae Urba et Barbarae Conjugis ejus. [škrtnuto: Testes] Susanna Conjux Caspari Pacha. [škrtnuto: Teste; nad řádkem: Levans] Maria Conjux Christiani Wagner, et [škrtnuto: Josephus; nad řádkem: Testis] Petrus Scholtz judex omnes Petrovicio.
entries.notes: Svědek Petrus Scholtz výslovně označen jako 'judex' (petrovický rychtář). Písař opravil role kmotrů nad řádkem.

entries.subject: Joannes Petrus
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Petrus Scholtz; Testes Ferdinandus Lux, Susanna filia Christiani Esler
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 27 | Baptizatus est Joannes Petrus filius Caspari Adler et Susannae Conjugis ejus. Levans Petrus Scholtz. Testes Ferdinandus Lux, et Susanna filia Christiani Esler omnes Petrovicio
entries.notes: Zapsáno na řádku po 29. 3. (Sobkovicio).

entries.subject: Theresia
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Elisabetha Conjux Ferdinandi Lux; Testes Anna Conjux Zachariae Schroller, Joannes Pacha
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 8 | Baptizata est Theresia filia Friderici Epel et Susannae Conjugis ejus Levans Elisabetha Conjux Ferdinandi Lux. Testes Anna Conjux Zachariae Schroller et Joannes Pacha omnes Petrovicio.

entries.subject: Anna Theresia
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Rosina filia Georgij Henrich; Testes Rosina Conjux Caspari Wagner, Georgius Adam Exner ex Rothflößl
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 13 | Baptizata est Anna Theresia filia Josephi Schmok et Annae Conjugis ejus. Levans Rosina filia Georgij Henrich. Testes Rosina Conjux Caspari Wagner et Georgius Adam Exner ex Rothflößl reliq. Petrovicio.

entries.subject: Joannes Josephus
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Casparus Wagner; Testes Susanna Conjux Joannis Steiner, Catharina Conjux Salomonis Schön
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 13 | Baptizatus est Joannes Josephus filius Josephi Weber et Elisabethae Conjugis ejus. Levans Casparus Wagner. Testes Susanna Conjux Joannis Steiner et Catharina Conjux Salomonis Schön omnes Petrovicio.

entries.subject: Antonius
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Andreas Albel ex Germanico Petersdorff; Testes Petrus Folkner, Salomon Schön, Petri Scholtz uxor Maria, Regina Conjux Christophori Wagner
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | eod. [18.] | Baptizatus est Antonius filius Jeremiae Langer et Annae Conjugis ejus. Levans Andreas Albel ex Germanico Petersdorff. Testes Petrus Folkner, et Salomon Schön et Petri Scholtz uxor Maria et Regina Conjux Christophori Wagner omnes reliq. ex Boëm Petrovic.
entries.notes: Opět výslovné rozlišení kmotra 'ex Germanico Petersdorff' (Petrovičky) od rodičů a ostatních kmotrů 'ex Boëm Petrovic' (České Petrovice).

entries.subject: Joannes Christophorus
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Josephus Weber; Testes Catharina Conjux Salomonis Schön, Maria Conjux Joannis Pacha
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 20. | Baptizatus est Joannes Christophorus filius Joannis Esler junioris, et Magdalenae Conjugis ejus. Levans Josephus Weber. Testes Catharina Conjux Salomonis Schön et Maria Conjux Joannis Pacha oes Petrovicio.

entries.subject: Josephus Felix
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Christophorus Epel; Testes Georgius Hoffman, Maria Conjux Antonij Sauer Gšhakio(?) [Čihakio?]
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | eod. [20.] | Baptizatus est Josephus Felix filius Christophori Reynelt et Mariae Conjugis ejus. Levans Christophorus Epel. Testes Georgius Hoffman et Maria Conjux Antonij Sauer Gšhakio(?) [Čihakio?] hoc, reliq Petrovicio.
entries.notes: Svědkyně Maria, žena Antonína Sauera z Čiháku ('Gšhakio(?) [Čihakio?] hoc').

entries.subject: Antonius
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Antonius Lux; Testes Casparus Wagner, Elisabetha Conjux Petri Folkner
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 18. | Baptizatus est Antonius filius Christiani Schroller et Annae Mariae Conjugis ejus. Levans Antonius Lux Testes Casparus Wagner et Elisabetha Conjux Petri Folkner, omnes [škrtnuto: Sabko] Petrovicio.
entries.notes: Písař na konci škrtl nedopsané 'Sabko' a nahradil 'Petrovicio'.

entries.subject: Antonius (1. z dvojčat)
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Joannes Georgius Steiner; Testes Joannes Buchtel Pastwinio, Elisabetha Conjux Petri Folkner
entries.transcription: Petrovicio Gemini | 1 | Baptizati sunt Gemini quorum Parens Georgius Schmok, Mater Barbara: 1mus nomine Antonius Cujus Levans Joannes Georgius Steiner. Testes Joannes Buchtel Pastwinio et Elisabetha Conjux Petri Folkner 2dus infans vocat[us] n[om]ine Anna Maria. Cujus Levans Maria Conjux Henrici Reynelt. Testes Rosina Conjux Christophori Wagner et Christianus Wagner omnes reliq. Petrovicio.
entries.notes: První z dvojčat (Gemini) Jiřího Schmoka a Barbary. Svědek Joannes Buchtel z Pastvin ('Pastwinio').

entries.subject: Anna Maria (2. z dvojčat)
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Maria Conjux Henrici Reynelt; Testes Rosina Conjux Christophori Wagner, Christianus Wagner
entries.transcription: Petrovicio Gemini | 1 | Baptizati sunt Gemini quorum Parens Georgius Schmok, Mater Barbara: 1mus nomine Antonius Cujus Levans Joannes Georgius Steiner. Testes Joannes Buchtel Pastwinio et Elisabetha Conjux Petri Folkner 2dus infans vocat[us] n[om]ine Anna Maria. Cujus Levans Maria Conjux Henrici Reynelt. Testes Rosina Conjux Christophori Wagner et Christianus Wagner omnes reliq. Petrovicio.
entries.notes: Druhé z dvojčat (Gemini) Jiřího Schmoka a Barbary.

entries.subject: Anna Maria Margaretha
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Theresia Conjux Josephi Scholtz Molitoris; Testes Anna Conjux Zachariae Schroller, Philippus Herman
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 12. | Baptizata est Anna Maria Margaretha filia Josephi Kyttner et Rosinae Conjugis ejus. Levans Theresia Conjux Josephi Scholtz Molitoris. Testes, Anna Conjux Zachariae Schroller et Philippus Herman omnes Petrovicio.
entries.notes: Kmotra Terezie, manželka mlynáře Josefa Scholtze ('Josephi Scholtz Molitoris').

entries.subject: Kilianus Antonius
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Petrus Scholtz; Testes Christianus Lux, Susanna Conjux Josephi Scholtz Teloniarij, Anna Maria Conjux Christophori Epel
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | Dito [25] | Baptizatus est Kilianus Antonius filius Joannis Steiner et Susannae Conjugis ejus. Levans Petrus Scholtz. Testes Christianus Lux et Susanna Conjux Josephi Scholtz Teloniarij et Anna Maria Conjux Christophori Epel omnes Petrovicio.
entries.notes: Svědkyně Zuzana, manželka celníka Josefa Scholtze ('Josephi Scholtz Teloniarij').

entries.subject: Antonius
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Joannes Georgius Langer; Testes Ferdinandus Lux, Elisabetha Conjux Petri Volkmar
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 12. | Baptizatus est Antonius filius Christophori Esler et Rosinae Conjugis ejus. Levans Joannes Georgius Langer. Testes Ferdinandus Lux et Elisabetha Conjux Petri Volkmar omnes Petrovicio.
entries.notes: Příjmení 'Volkmar' (dříve psáno 'Folkner' / 'Folqmer').

entries.subject: Anna Rosina
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Maria Conjux Joannis Pacha; Testes Maria Conjux Georgij Hoffman, Petrus Volkmar, Josephus Scholtz vulgo Pistor
entries.transcription: Petrovicio | 22 | Baptizata est Anna Rosina filia Joannis Wagner et Reginae Conjugis ejus. Levans Maria Conjux Joannis Pacha. Testes Maria Conjux Georgij Hoffman, Petrus Volkmar et Josephus Scholtz vulgo Pistor.
entries.notes: Svědek 'Josephus Scholtz vulgo Pistor' (řečený Pekař).

entries.village_tag: Wikstadij baptizati qui Petrovicii (ex Petersdorff / Boëmo Petersdorffio)
entries.subject: Anna Elisabetha (1. z dvojčat)
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Anna Elisab Conjux Antonij Singer Wikstadij; Testes Anna Elisab. Conjux Zachariae Leypelt, Josephus Sagner (omnes hi Wixstadij)
entries.transcription: Wikstadij baptizati qui Petrovicii Gemini | 27. | Nati et baptizati sunt ibid[em] Gemini filii Parochianorum Nekorziensis Beneficij ex Petersdorff Parentum. 1mus infans Anna Elisabetha filia Caspari Kyttner et Reginae Conjugis ejus [nad řádkem: Petersdorffio]. Levans Anna Elisab Conjux Antonij Singer Wikstadij. Testes Anna Elisab. Conjux Zachariae Leypelt et Josephus Sagner omnes hi Wixstadij. 2dus infans eorundem Parentum vocatus Eleonora. Ejus Levans erat Maria Conjux Francisci Picz. Testes Maria Conjux Michaëlis Hoffman et Caspar Schmok ultimi hi 2 [nad řádkem: Wikstad.(?)] Boëmo Petersdorffio. Baptizavit A R D. Beschorner Wixst. Curat.
entries.notes: První z dvojčat (Gemini) z Českých Petrovic ('ex Petersdorff Parentum' / 'Boëmo Petersdorffio'), narozených a pokřtěných v Mladkově (Wickstadtl) kurátem Beschornerem.

entries.village_tag: Wikstadij baptizati qui Petrovicii (ex Petersdorff / Boëmo Petersdorffio)
entries.subject: Eleonora (2. z dvojčat)
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Maria Conjux Francisci Picz; Testes Maria Conjux Michaëlis Hoffman, Caspar Schmok (Boëmo Petersdorffio)
entries.transcription: Wikstadij baptizati qui Petrovicii Gemini | 27. | Nati et baptizati sunt ibid[em] Gemini filii Parochianorum Nekorziensis Beneficij ex Petersdorff Parentum. 1mus infans Anna Elisabetha filia Caspari Kyttner et Reginae Conjugis ejus [nad řádkem: Petersdorffio]. Levans Anna Elisab Conjux Antonij Singer Wikstadij. Testes Anna Elisab. Conjux Zachariae Leypelt et Josephus Sagner omnes hi Wixstadij. 2dus infans eorundem Parentum vocatus Eleonora. Ejus Levans erat Maria Conjux Francisci Picz. Testes Maria Conjux Michaëlis Hoffman et Caspar Schmok ultimi hi 2 [nad řádkem: Wikstad.(?)] Boëmo Petersdorffio. Baptizavit A R D. Beschorner Wixst. Curat.
entries.notes: Druhé z dvojčat (Gemini) z Českých Petrovic, narozených a pokřtěných v Mladkově. Nad 'Boëmo' je mezi řádky připsáno 'Wikstad.(?)' (nejspíš doplněk původu kmotry Marie Piczové nebo oprava).

entries.subject: Catharina
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Susanna Conjux Josephi Scholtz Teloniarij Petrovic.; Testes Maria Conjux Joannis Pacha, Joannes Kyttnar
entries.transcription: Petrovicio [škrtnuto: Nekorzio] | 11 | Baptizata est Catharina filia Christiani Wagner et Mariae Conjugis ejus Levans Susanna Conjux Josephi Scholtz Teloniarij Petrovic. Testes Maria Conjux Joannis Pacha, Joannes Kyttnar omnes Petrovicio.
entries.notes: Marginálie opravena ze škrtnutého 'Nekorzio' na 'Petrovicio'. Kmotra Zuzana, manželka celníka Josefa Scholtze ('Teloniarij Petrovic.').

entries.subject: Catharina
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Anna Conjux Zachariae Schroller; Testes Rosina Conjux Caspari Wagner, Joannes Bayer
entries.transcription: Petroviciô | 17 | Baptizata est Catharina filia Joannis Epel et Rosinae Conjugis ejus. Levans Anna Conjux Zachariae Schroller. Testes Rosina Conjux Caspari Wagner, et Joannes Bayer, o[mn]es Petroviciô. Baptizavit R. D. Beschorner Curatus Wikstadj.
entries.notes: Zapsáno po záznamu z 26. 11. 1732 (opožděný zápis křtu provedeného mladkovským kurátem).

entries.subject: Theresia
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Elisabetha Conjux Antonij Lux; Testes Susanna Conjux Caspari Pacha, Christianus Wagner
entries.transcription: Petroviciô | 30 | Baptizata est Theresia filia Antonij Scholtz et Catharinae Conjugis ejus. Levans Elisabetha Conjux Antonij Lux. Testes Susanna Conjux Caspari Pacha et Christianus Wagner omnes Petroviciô.

entries.subject: Franciscus Andreas
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Joannes Kyttner; Testes Christoph Reynelt, Maria Conjux Joannis Urba
entries.transcription: Petroviciô | 1 | Baptizatus e[st] Franc. Andreas filius Georgij Hoffman et Clarae Conjugis ejus. Levans Joannes Kyttner. Testes Christoph Reynelt, et Maria Conjux Joannis Urba, o[mn]es Petroviciô.

entries.subject: Theresia
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Maria Conjux Christiani Herman; Testes Catharina Conjux Salomonis Shön, Christianus Lux
entries.transcription: Petroviciô | 27 | Baptizata est Theresia filia Josephi Scholtz in büsenmühl Molitoris et Theresiae Conjugis ejus. Levans Maria Conjux Christiani Herman. Testes Catharina Conjux Salomonis Shön et Christianus Lux omnes Petroviciô.
entries.notes: Otec výslovně uveden jako mlynář v Dolním mlýně ('in büsenmühl Molitoris').

entries.subject: Birgitta
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Elisabetha Conjux Ferdinandi Lux; Testes Susanna Conjux Christophori Herman, Georgius Hoffman
entries.transcription: Petroviciô | eod | Baptizata est Birgitta filia Joannis Urban et Mariae Conjugis ejus. Levans Elisabetha Conjux Ferdinandi Lux. Testes Susanna Conjux Christophori Herman et Georgius Hoffman omnes Petroviciô.
entries.notes: Datum 'eod' navazuje na předchozí zápis ze 4. 1. 1733 (Linsdorffio).

entries.subject: Josephus
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Caspar Schmok; Testes Georgius Schmok, Anna Conjux Zachariae Schroller
entries.transcription: Petroviciô baptizavit R. P. Franciscanus in Collect: | 21 | Baptizatus est Josephus filius Christiani Esler junioris, et Reginae Conjugis ejus. Levans Caspar Schmok. Testes Georgius Schmok, et Anna Conjux Zachariae Schroller omnes Petroviciô.
entries.notes: V marginálii připsán křtící kněz: františkán na kolektě ('baptizavit R.P. Franciscanus in Collect:').

entries.subject: Birgitta
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Maria Conjux Christiani Herman; Testes Susanna Conjux Joannis Steiner, Salomon Schön
entries.transcription: Petroviciô | 19 | Baptizata est Birgitta filia Christophori Esler et Mariae Conjugis ejus. Levans Maria Conjux Christiani Herman. Testes Susanna Conjux Joannis Steiner, et Salomon Schön omnes Petrovicio.
entries.notes: Zapsáno za zápisem z 21. 1. 1733.

entries.subject: Birgitta Apollonia
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Birgitta Conjux Josephi Schroller; Testes Josephus Scholtz der büsenmüller, Rosina Conjux Caspari Wagner
entries.transcription: Petroviciô | 9 | Baptizata est Birgitta Apollonia filia Antonij Beyer, et Mariae Conjugis ejus. Levans Birgitta Conjux Josephi Schroller. Testes Josephus Scholtz der büsenmüller, et Rosina Conjux Caspari Wagner omnes Petroviciô.
entries.notes: Svědek 'Josephus Scholtz der büsenmüller'.

entries.subject: Anna Susanna
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Susanna Conjux Joannis Steiner; Testes Caspar Pacha, Josephus Sholtz büsenmüller
entries.priest: jdem P. Servita (R. P. Servita Lambertus)
entries.transcription: Petroviciô | 24 | Baptizata est Anna Susanna filia Christiani Lux et Susannae Conjugis ejus. Levans Susanna Conjux Joannis Steiner. Testes Caspar Pacha et Josephus Sholtz büsenmüller, omnes Petroviciô. Baptizavit jdem P. Servita.
entries.notes: Kněz 'idem P. Servita' odkazuje na výše uvedeného P. Lamberta servitu.

entries.subject: Joannes Georgius
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Christianus Herman; Testes Catharina Conjux Friderici Kyttner, Regina Conjux Christophori Wagner
entries.transcription: Petroviciô | 6 | Baptizatus est Joannes Georgius filius Caspari Wagner et Rosinae Conjugis ejus. Levans Christianus Herman. Testes Catharina Conjux Friderici Kyttner et Regina Conjux Christophori Wagner omnes Petroviciô. Baptizavit R. P. Servita Lambertus.

entries.subject: Antonius
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Joannes Steiner; Testes Christophorus Esler, Maria Conjux Christiani Herman
entries.transcription: Petroviciô | 15 | Baptizatus est Antonius filius Petri Scholtz et Annae Mariae Conjugis ejus. Levans Joannes Steiner. Testes Christophorus Esler et Maria Conjux Christiani Herman omnes Petroviciô.

entries.subject: Birgitta
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Susanna Conjux Joannis Steiner; Testes Elisabeth Conjux Ferdinandi Lux, Casparus Adler
entries.transcription: Petroviciô | eod | Baptizata est Birgitta filia Joannis Herman et Catharinae Conjugis ejus. Levans Susanna Conjux Joannis Steiner. Testes Elisabeth Conjux Ferdinandi Lux et Casparus Adler omnes Petroviciô.
entries.notes: Datum 'eod' navazuje na předchozí zápis z 22. 3. 1733 (Linsdorffio).

entries.subject: Antonius
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Petrus Scholtz; Testes Christophorus Esler, Elisabetha Conjux Ferdinandi Lux
entries.transcription: Petroviciô | 10 | Baptizatus est Antonius filius Antonij Lux et Elisabethae Conjugis ejus. Levans Petrus Scholtz. Testes Christophorus Esler et Elisabetha Conjux Ferdinandi Lux, omnes Petroviciô.

entries.subject: Anna Rosina
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Anna Rosina filia post def. Georgium Henrich; Testes Catharina Conjux Friderici Kyttner, Caspar Pacha
entries.transcription: Petroviciô | 26 | Baptizata est Anna Rosina filia Josephi Peschke et Elisabethae Conjugis ejus. Levans Anna Rosina filia post def. Georgium Henrich. Testes Catharina Conjux Friderici Kyttner et Caspar Pacha omnes Petroviciô.

entries.subject: Anna Theresia
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Susanna Conjux Josephi Scholtz Teloniarij; Testes Susanna Conjux Caspari Pacha, Antonius Scholtz
entries.transcription: Petroviciô | 28 | Baptizata est Anna Theresia filia Michaëlis Hofman et Annae Mariae Conjugis ejus. Levans Susanna Conjux Josephi Scholtz Teloniarij. Testes Susanna Conjux Caspari Pacha, et Antonius Scholtz, omnes Petroviciô.
entries.notes: Kmotra Zuzana, manželka celníka Josefa Scholtze ('Teloniarij').

entries.subject: Anna Maria
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Anna Maria filia Caspari Pacha; Testes Petrus Scholtz, Antonius Lux
entries.transcription: Petroviciô | 10 | Baptizata est Anna Maria filia Josephi Bliemel et Mariae Conjugis ejus. Levans Anna Maria filia Caspari Pacha. Testes Petrus Scholtz et Antonius Lux omnes Petroviciô.

entries.subject: Barbara (1. z dvojčat)
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Susanna Conjux Josephi Scholtz Teloniarij; Testes Maria Conjux Christiani Herman, Christoph Wagner
entries.priest: me p.t. Curato Nekorž. (sub conditione; priùs ab obstetrice)
entries.transcription: Petroviciô Gemini | 13 | Baptizati sunt Gemini, quorum Parentes: Martinus Schön et Catharina Conjux ejus. 1mus infans vocatus: Barbara baptizata à me p.t. Curato Nekorž. sub Condi[tio]ne quia et priùs ab obstetrice baptizata fuerat. Levans ejus Susanna Conjux Josephi Scholtz Teloniarij. Testes Maria Conjux Christiani Herman et Christoph Wagner omnes Petroviciô. 2dus infans baptizatus tantummodo ab instructa obstetrice ibid. et mortuus.
entries.notes: První z dvojčat (Gemini), pokřtěná podmíněně nekořským kurátem poté, co byla dříve pokřtěna porodní bábou. Poslední doložená zmínka celníka Josefa Scholtze ještě za života (kmotra jeho manželka Zuzana).

entries.subject: N.N. (2. z dvojčat, + po křtu)
entries.transcription: Petroviciô Gemini | 13 | Baptizati sunt Gemini, quorum Parentes: Martinus Schön et Catharina Conjux ejus. [...] 2dus infans baptizatus tantummodo ab instructa obstetrice ibid. et mortuus.
entries.notes: Druhé z dvojčat (Gemini), pokřtěné pouze poučenou porodní bábou v Petrovicích ('ab instructa obstetrice ibid.') a zemřelé; křestní jméno neuvedeno.

entries.subject: Anna Elisabetha
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Birgitta Conjux Josephi Schroller; Testes Catharina Conjux Friderici Kyttner, Christianus Herman
entries.transcription: Petroviciô | 3 | Baptizata est Anna Elisabetha filia Christiani Steiner et Birgittae Conjugis ejus. Levans Birgitta Conjux Josephi Schroller. Testes Catharina Conjux Friderici Kyttner et Christianus Herman omnes Petroviciô

entries.subject: Anna Maria
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Elisabetha filia post def. Joannem Herman Seniorem; Testes Rosina Conjux Josephi Kittner, Caspar Wagner junior
entries.transcription: Petroviciô [škrtnuto: Linsdorffio] | 9 | Baptizata est Anna Maria filia Josephi Esler et Mariae Conjugis ejus. Levans Elisabetha filia post def. Joannem Herman Seniorem. Testes Rosina Conjux Josephi Kittner et Caspar Wagner junior omnes Petroviciô.
entries.notes: Marginálie opravena ze škrtnutého 'Linsdorffio' na 'Petroviciô'. Číslice dne 9. mezi zápisem z 8. 8. (eod.) a 23. 8.

entries.subject: Antonius
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Christophorus Esler; Testes Susanna Conjux Joannis Steiner, Susanna Conjux Caspari Adler
entries.transcription: Petroviciô | Dito | Baptizatus est Antonius filius Joannis Postler et Mariae Conjugis ejus. Levans Christophorus Esler. Testes Susanna Conjux Joannis Steiner et Susanna Conjux Caspari Adler omnes Petroviciô.
entries.notes: Datum 'Dito' navazuje na předchozí zápis z 23. 8. 1733 (Welsdorffio).

entries.subject: Joannes Franciscus
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Christianus Herman; Testes Christianus Wagner, Georgius Hoffman
entries.transcription: Petroviciô | 23 | Baptizatus est Joannes Franciscus sub Conditione filius Zachariae Schroller et Annae Conjugis ejus. Levans Christianus Herman. Testes Christianus Wagner et Georgius Hoffman omnes [škrtnuto: Linsdorff] Petroviciô.
entries.notes: Podmíněný křest ('sub Conditione'); na konci škrtnuto omylem psané 'Linsdorff' a nahrazeno 'Petroviciô'.

entries.subject: Antonius Linus
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Petrus Scholtz; Testes Susanna Conjux Caspari Pacha, Maria Conjux Christiani Wagner
entries.transcription: Petroviciô | 23 | Baptizatus est Antonius Linus filius Andreae Urba et Barbarae Conjugis ejus. Levans Petrus Scholtz [škrtnuto: Scholtz]. Testes Susanna Conjux Caspari Pacha, et Maria Conjux Christiani Wagner omnes Petroviciô.

entries.subject: Anna Maria
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Anna Rosina filia post def. Georgium Henrich; Testes Regina Conjux Christophori Wagner, Catharina vidua post def. Salomonem Schön, Caspar Adler
entries.transcription: Petroviciô | eod | Baptizata est Anna Maria filia Josephi Lux et Apolloniae Conjugis ejus. Levans Anna Rosina filia post def. Georgium Henrich. Testes Regina Conjux Christophori Wagner et Catharina vidua post def. Salomonem Schön, et Caspar Adler omnes Petroviciô.
entries.notes: Datum 'eod' navazuje na předchozí zápis ze 14. 10. 1733 (Nekorziô).

entries.subject: Ottilia Theresia
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Magdalena Conjux Caspari Schmok; Testes Susanna Conjux Caspari Pacha, Joannes Kyttner
entries.transcription: Petroviciô | 13 | Baptizata est [škrtnuto: Anna] Ottilia Theresia filia Joannis Georgij Langer et Elisabethae Conjugis ejus. Levans Magdalena Conjux Caspari Schmok Testes Susanna Conjux Caspari Pacha, et Joannes Kyttner, o[mn]es Petroviciô.
entries.notes: Před jménem 'Ottilia Theresia' je zřetelně škrtnuté 'Anna'.

entries.subject: Anna Maria
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Anna Rosina Vid. post def. Georg. Henrich; Testes Anna M[a]ria Conj. Christophori Epel, Anna M[a]ria Conj. Georgij Vogel, Casparus Pacha
entries.transcription: Petroviciô | 17 | Baptizata est Anna Maria filia Henrici Reynelt et Annae Mariae Conjugis ejus. Levans: Anna Rosina Vid. post def. Georg. Henrich. Testes: Anna M[a]ria Conj. Christophori Epel, et Anna M[a]ria Conj. Georgij Vogel et Casparus Pacha o[mn]es Petrf. Baptizavit Altarista Geyersbg. Wiesner
entries.notes: Křtil kyšperský (letohradský) altarista Wiesner.

entries.subject: Joannes Antonius
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Joannes Kyttner Petroviciô; Testes Antonius Sauer Čžihakiô, Maria Conjux Christophori Epel Petroviciô
entries.transcription: Petroviciô | 25 | Baptizatus est Joannes Antonius filius Christophori Reynelt et Mariae Conjugis ejus. Levans Joannes Kyttner Petroviciô. Testes Antonius Sauer Čžihakiô et Maria Conjux Christophori Epel Petroviciô Baptizavit Wixst. D. Curatus Beschorner
entries.notes: Svědek Antonius Sauer výslovně z Čiháku ('Čžihakiô'). Zapsáno za zápisem z 26. 12. (Studená).

entries.subject: Theresia
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Susanna Conjux Joannis Steiner; Testes Maria Conjux Georgij Hoffman, Christianus Wagner
entries.transcription: Petroviciô | 4 | Baptizata est Theresia filia Joannis Kittner et Mariae Conjugis ejus. Levans Susanna Conjux Joannis Steiner. Testes Maria Conjux Georgij Hoffman et Christianus Wagner omnes Petroviciô. Baptizavit ARD. Beschorner Curat. Wixst.
entries.notes: Zapsáno za zápisem z 8. 1. 1734 (opožděné zanesení křtu mladkovského kuráta ze 4. 1.).

entries.subject: Barbara
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Birgitta Conjux Josephi Schroller; Testes Elisabeth Conjux Antonij Lux, Christianus Herman
entries.transcription: Petroviciô | 10 | Baptizata est Barbara filia Josephi Epel et Ceciliae Conjugis ejus. Levans Birgitta Conjux Josephi Schroller. Testes Elisabeth Conjux Antonij Lux et Christianus Herman omnes Petroviciô.

entries.subject: Joannes Fridericus
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Joseph Schroller; Testes Joann Steiner, Regina Conjux Christoph Wagner
entries.transcription: Petroviciô [škrtnuto: Linsdorffiô] | 17 | Baptizatus est Joannes Fridericus filius Friderici Reynelt et Mariae Conjugis ejus. Levans Joseph Schroller. Testes Joann Steiner, et Regina Conjux Christoph Wagner
entries.notes: Marginálie opravena ze škrtnutého 'Linsdorffiô' na 'Petroviciô'.

entries.subject: Anna Theresia
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Rosina Conjux Caspari Wagner Senioris; Testes Regina Conjux Christiani Reynelt Welsdorffio, Casparus Wagner junior Petrov.
entries.transcription: Petroviciô | 4 | Baptizata est Anna Theresia filia Friderici Kyttner et Catharinae Conjugis ejus. Levans Rosina Conjux Caspari Wagner Senioris. Testes Regina Conjux Christiani Reynelt Welsdorffio et Casparus Wagner junior Petrov.

entries.subject: Anna Theresia
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Maria filia Ferdinandi Lux; Testes Rosina [nad škrtnutým Susanna] Conjux Caspari Wagner, Petrus Scholtz, Christoph Epel
entries.transcription: Petersdorffiô | 19 | Baptizata est Anna Theresia filia Joannis Wagner et Catharinae Conjugis ejus. Levans Maria filia Ferdinandi Lux. Testes Rosina [škrtnuto: Susanna] Conjux Caspari Wagner et Petrus Scholtz, Christoph Epel omnes Petersdorffiô.
entries.notes: Křestní jméno manželky Kašpara Wagnera opraveno nad řádkem ze škrtnutého 'Susanna' na 'Rosina'.

entries.subject: Ludmilla
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Maria Conjux Christiani Herman; Testes Susanna Conjux Joannis Steiner, Susanna vidua post def. Salomonem Schoen, Georg Adam Exner ex Rothflösl., Georg Hoffman, Antonius Wagner
entries.transcription: Petroviciô | 22 | Baptizata est Ludmilla filia Josephi Wagner et Annae Conjugis ejus. Levans Maria Conjux Christiani Herman. Testes Susanna Conjux Joannis Steiner et Susanna vidua post def. Salomonem Schoen et Georg Adam Exner ex Rothflösl. et Georg Hoffman et Antonius Wagner reliq. Petroviciô.
entries.notes: Svědek Georg Adam Exner z Červeného Potoka ('ex Rothflösl.').

entries.subject: Ludmilla
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Anna Maria Conjux Petri Scholtz; Testes Maria Conjux Joannis Urba, Casparus Pacha
entries.transcription: Petroviciô | 7 | Baptizata est Ludmilla filia Caspari Schmok et Magdalenae Conjugis ejus. Levans Anna Maria Conjux Petri Scholtz. Testes Maria Conjux Joannis Urba. et Casparus Pacha omnes Petroviciô.

entries.subject: Antonius
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Antonius Lux; Testes Casparus Wagner, Anna Conjux Zachariae Schroller, Anna Maria Conjux Georgij Hoffman
entries.transcription: Petersdorffio | 22 | Baptizatus est Antonius, filius Joannis Georgij Nahlik et Annae Mariae Conjugis ejus. Levans Antonius Lux. Testes Casparus Wagner et Anna Conjux Zachariae Schroller et Anna Maria Conjux Georgij Hoffman o[mn]es Petroviciô.
entries.notes: Rod Náhlíků výslovně zapsán pod Českými Petrovicemi ('Petersdorffio', 'o[mn]es Petroviciô').

entries.subject: Anna Maria
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Susanna Conjux Caspari Pacha; Testes Maria Conjux Josephi Wagner, Caspar Wagner Rusticus Inferior
entries.transcription: Petroviciô | 25 | Baptizata est Anna Maria filia Christiani Lux infimi et Susannae Conjugis ejus. Levans Susanna Conjux Caspari Pacha. Testes Maria Conjux Josephi Wagner et Caspar Wagner Rusticus Inferior omnes Petroviciô.
entries.notes: Rozlišovací přízviska v dolní části vsi: 'Christiani Lux infimi' a 'Caspar Wagner Rusticus Inferior'.

entries.subject: Norbertus Joannes Josephus
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Caspar Schmok; Testes Mathias Esler, Maria Conj. Michaëlis Hoffman
entries.transcription: Petersdorffiô | 6 | Baptizatus est Norbertus Joannes Josephus filius Caspari Kyttner et Reginae Conjugis ejus. Levans Caspar Schmok. Testes Mathias Esler, et Maria Conj. Michaëlis Hoffman.

entries.subject: Petrus (1. z dvojčat)
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Josephus Schroller faber; Testes Georg Adam Exner ex Rothflössl., Maria Conjux Christiani Wagner
entries.transcription: Petroviciô Gemini | 2 | Baptizati sunt Gemini Parentum: Michaelis Epel et Mariae Conjugis ejus 1mus infans vocatus Petrus. Levans ejus Josephus Schroller faber. Testes Georg Adam Exner ex Rothflössl. et Maria Conjux Christiani Wagner hi reliq. Petersd. 2dus infans vocat[us] Ludmilla filia eorund[em]. Levans ejus: Maria Conjux Christiani Herman. Testes Elisabeth Conjux Antonij Lux et Caspar Pacha o[mn]es hi Petrovicij Baptizavit ARD. Andreas Beschorner Curat. Wixstadj
entries.notes: První z dvojčat (Gemini), pokřtěno po předchozím zápisu ze 4. 7. 1734 mladkovským kurátem Beschornerem. Kmotr 'Josephus Schroller faber' (kovář).

entries.subject: Ludmilla (2. z dvojčat)
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Maria Conjux Christiani Herman; Testes Elisabeth Conjux Antonij Lux, Caspar Pacha
entries.transcription: Petroviciô Gemini | 2 | Baptizati sunt Gemini Parentum: Michaelis Epel et Mariae Conjugis ejus [...] 2dus infans vocat[us] Ludmilla filia eorund[em]. Levans ejus: Maria Conjux Christiani Herman. Testes Elisabeth Conjux Antonij Lux et Caspar Pacha o[mn]es hi Petrovicij Baptizavit ARD. Andreas Beschorner Curat. Wixstadj
entries.notes: Druhé z dvojčat (Gemini) téhož páru.

entries.subject: Theresia
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Susanna Conjux Zachariae Schroller; Testes Catharina vidua post def. Salomonem Schoen, Joannes Steiner, Michaël Hoffman
entries.transcription: Petroviciô | eod | Baptizata est Theresia filia Philippi Herman et Mariae Conjugis ejus. Levans Susanna Conjux Zachariae Schroller. Testes Catharina vidua post def. Salomonem Schoen, et Joannes Steiner, Michaël Hoffman o[mn]es Petroviciô.
entries.notes: Datum 'eod' navazuje na předchozí zápis ze 13. 7. 1734 (Welsdorffio).

entries.subject: Petrus
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Petrus Scholtz; Testes Joannes Steiner, Maria Conjux Christiani Herman
entries.transcription: Petroviciô | 30 | Baptizatus est Petrus filius Joannis Bayer et Mariae Conjugis ejus. Levans Petrus Scholtz. Testes Joannes Steiner et Maria Conjux Christiani Herman omnes Petroviciô.
entries.notes: Zapsáno před záznamem z 25. 7. 1734 (Linsdorffio).

entries.subject: Maria Anna Elisabetha
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Theresia Conjux Josephi Scholtz Molitoris sive vulgo büsenmüllers; Testes Elisabetha Conjux Petri Folkner, Antonius Scholtz
entries.role: molitor (manžel kmotry, molitoris sive vulgo büsenmüllers)
entries.transcription: Petroviciô | eod | Baptizata est Maria Anna Elisabetha filia Joannis Wagner et Reginae Conjugis ejus. Levans Theresia [škrtnuto: fil.] Conjux Josephi Scholtz Molitoris sivulgo büsenmüllers :/. Testes Elisabetha Conjux Petri Folkner et Antonius Scholtz omnes Petersdorffiô.
entries.notes: Datum 'eod' navazuje na předchozí zápis z 5. 8. 1734 (Welsdorffio). Kmotra 'Theresia Conjux Josephi Scholtz Molitoris sivulgo büsenmüllers'.

entries.subject: Anna Margaretha
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Rosina filia post def. Georgium Henrich; Testes Rosina Conjux Caspari Wagner, Georgius Adamus Exner ex Rothflösl
entries.transcription: Petroviciô | 17 | Baptizata est Anna Margaretha filia Josephi Schmok et Annae Conjugis ejus. Levans Rosina filia post def. Georgium Henrich. Testes Rosina Conjux Caspari Wagner et Georgius Adamus Exner ex Rothflösl, reliq. Petrovic.

entries.subject: Joannes Petrus
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Christianus Herman; Testes Christianus Wagner, Susanna Vidua post def. Josephum Scholtz Teloniarium
entries.transcription: Petroviciô | 25 | Baptizatus est Joannes Petrus filius Martini Schön et Catharinae Conjugis ejus. Levans Christianus Herman. Testes Christianus Wagner et Susanna Vidua post def. Josephum Scholtz Teloniarium Baptizavit ARD. Beschorner pt. Curat. Wikstadj
entries.notes: Nejstarší doložený výskyt Zuzany jako vdovy po zemřelém celníkovi Josefu Scholtzovi ('Susanna Vidua post def. Josephum Scholtz Teloniarium'), již v srpnu 1734.

entries.subject: Andreas Joannes Josephus
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Joannes Steiner; Testes Ferdinandus Lux, Joannes Bayer, Maria Conjux Christiani Herman
entries.transcription: Petroviciô | 30 | Baptizatus est Andreas Joannes Josephus filius Christophori Epel et Annae Mariae Conjugis ejus. Levans Joannes Steiner. Testes Ferdinandus Lux et Joannes Bayer et Maria Conjux Christiani Herman omnes Petersdorffiô.

entries.subject: Joannes Josephus
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Joannes Pacha; Testes Michaël Weber, Rosina Conjux Caspari Wagner Senioris, Anna Conjux Zachariae Schroller
entries.transcription: Petersdorffio | 15 | Baptizatus est Joannes Josephus filius Joannis Epel et Rosinae Conjugis ejus. Levans Joannes Pacha. Testes Michaël Weber, et Rosina Conjux Caspari Wagner Senioris, et Anna Conjux Zachariae Schroller omnes Petersdj.

entries.subject: Florianus
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Caspar Pacha; Testes Josephus Scholtz der büsenmüller, Caspar Adler, Susanna Conjux Joannis Steiner
entries.transcription: Petroviciô | 2 | Baptizatus est Florianus filius Christiani Lux et Susannae Conjugis ejus, Levans Caspar Pacha. Testes Josephus Scholtz der büsenmüller, et Caspar Adler, et Susanna Conjux Joannis Steiner omnes Petersdorffiô.

entries.subject: Anna Rosina
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Anna Conjux Zachariae Schroller; Testes Maria Conjux Philippi Herman, Josephus Scholtz Büsenmüller
entries.transcription: Linsdorffiô | 30 | Baptizata est Anna Rosina filia Josephi Kyttner et Rosinae Conjugis ejus Levans: Anna Conjux Zachariae Schroller. Testes: Maria Conjux Philippi Herman et Josephus Scholtz Büsenmüller, omnes Petersd[orffio].
entries.notes: Písařský omyl v levé marginálii ('Linsdorffiô'), avšak rodiče (Josephus Kyttner & Rosina), všichni kmotři (Anna Schroller, Maria Herman, mlynář Josephus Scholtz Büsenmüller) i závěrečná lokace ('omnes Petersd:') jednoznačně náležejí do Českých Petrovic.

entries.subject: Maria Theresia
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Birgita Conjux Josephi Schroller; Testes Maria Conj. Christiani Herman, Christophorus Wolff. Wixst[adj], Joseph Scholtz judex Petersd.
entries.transcription: Petersdorffi[o] | 31 | Baptizata est Maria Theresia filia Antonij Sstiepan et Annae Eleonorae Conjugis ejus. Levans Birgita Conjux Josephi Schroller. Testes Maria Conj. Christiani Herman et Christophorus Wolff. Wixst[adj], et Joseph Scholtz judex Petersd. reliq. Petersd.
entries.notes: Svědek 'Joseph Scholtz judex Petersd.' (petrovický rychtář).

entries.subject: Anna Maria
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Anna Maria Conjux Petri Scholtz; Testes Cathar. Vid. post def. Salom. Schön, Christianus Lux
entries.transcription: Petersdorffio | 9 | Baptizata est Anna Maria filia Caspari Adler et Susannae Conjugis ejus Levans Anna Maria Conjux Petri Scholtz. Testes Cathar. Vid. post def. Salom. Schön et Christianus Lux omnes Petersd.
entries.notes: Zapsáno za záznamem z 10. 2. 1735 (Sobkoviciô).

entries.subject: Anna Maria
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Elizabeth Conj. Antonij Lux; Testes Elizabeth Conj. Petri Folkner, Petrus Scholtz
entries.transcription: Petersdorff[io] | 21 | Baptizata est Anna Maria filia Georgij Vogel et Mariae Conjugis ejus, Levans Elizabeth Conj. Antonij Lux Testes Elizabeth Conj. Petri Folkner et Petrus Scholtz omnes Petersdorffiô.

entries.subject: Juliana Maria
entries.mother: Elisabetha Vidua post def. Godefridum Wagner
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Anna Rosina filia post def. Georgium Henrich; Testes Catharina Conj. Frid. Kyttner, Maria Conj. Joannis Pacha, Regina Conj. Christophori Wagner, Petrus Volkner, Joann Steiner
entries.transcription: Petroviciô Ex sinistro latere | 26 | Baptizata est Juliana Maria filia N.N. et Elisabethae Viduae post def. Godefridum Wagner. Levans Anna Rosina filia post def. Georgium Henrich Testes Catharina Conj. [škrtnuto: Josephi] Frid. Kyttner et Maria Conj. Joannis Pacha et Regina Conj. Christophori Wagner et Petrus Volkner et Joann Steiner omnes Petersd.
entries.notes: Nemanželské dítě ('Ex sinistro latere') vdovy Alžběty po zemřelém Gottfriedovi Wagnerovi; v textu opraveno jméno manžela Kateřiny Kyttnerové ze škrtnutého 'Josephi' na 'Frid.'

entries.subject: Maria Magdalena
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Susanna Conj. Christiani Lux; Testes Elizabeth Conj. Ferdin[an]di Lux, Christianus Herman
entries.transcription: Petroviciô | 27 | Baptizata est Maria Magdalena filia Josephi Scholtz des büsenmüllers et Theresiae Conjugis ejus. Levans Susanna Conj. Christiani Lux [škrtnuto slovo] Testes Elizabeth Conj. Ferdin[an]di Lux et Christianus Herman omnes Petroviciô.

entries.subject: Josephus
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Antonius Scholtz; Testes Caspar Pacha, Susanna Vidua post def. Josephum Scholtz Teloniarium
entries.transcription: Petersdorff[io] | 2 | Baptizatus est Josephus filius Michaëlis Hoffman et Mariae Conjugis ejus. Levans Antonius Scholtz, et Caspar Pacha et Susanna Vidua post def. Josephum Scholtz Teloniarium ultimi 2 Testes. o[mn]es Petersd.
entries.notes: Svědkyně 'Susanna Vidua post def. Josephum Scholtz Teloniarium'.

entries.subject: Anna Rosina
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Maria Conjux Christiani Wagner; Testes Maria Conjux Christiani Herman, Ferdinandus Lux
entries.transcription: Petersdorff[io] | 10 | Baptizata est Anna Rosina filia Friderici Epel et Susannae Conjugis ejus. Levans: Maria Conjux Christiani Wagner. Testes Maria Conjux Christiani Herman et Ferdinandus Lux omnes Petersd.

entries.subject: Theresia Josepha
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Maria Conjux Petri Scholtz; Testes Elizabeth Conjux Antonij Lux, Maria Conj. Wenceslai Richter Sobk[ovicio], Christianus Wagner
entries.transcription: Petersdorff[io] | eod | Baptizata est Theresia Josepha filia Josephi Blümel et Mariae Conjugis ejus. Levans Maria Conjux Petri Scholtz. Testes Elizabeth Conjux Antonij [škrtnuto: Scholtz] Lux. et Maria Conj. Wenceslai Richter Sobk[ovicio] et Christianus Wagner caeteri Petersd.
entries.notes: Datum 'eod' navazuje na předchozí zápis z 21. 3. 1735 (Audoliô). Příjmení za 'Antonij' opraveno ze škrtnutého 'Scholtz' na 'Lux'.

entries.subject: Anna Susanna
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Susanna Conjux Joannis Steiner; Testes Elisabeth Conjux Ferdinandi Lux, Casparus Adler
entries.transcription: Petersdorffio | eod | Baptizata est Anna Susanna filia Joannis Herman et Catharinae Conjugis ejus. Levans: Susanna Conjux Joannis Steiner et Elisabeth Conjux Ferdinandi Lux et Casparus Adler omnes Petersdorffio.
entries.notes: Datum 'eod' navazuje na předchozí zápis z 28. 3. 1735 (Audoliô, opravený přes škrtnuté Petersdorffs).

entries.subject: Ludmilla
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Maria Conjux Michaëlis Hoffman; Testes Maria Conjux Christiani Wagner, Catharina Conj. Friderici Kyttner, Antonius Lux
entries.transcription: Petersdorffi[o] | 11 | Baptizata est Ludmilla filia Antonij Scholtz et Catharinae Conjugis ejus. Levans: Maria Conjux Michaëlis Hoffman. Testes: Maria Conjux Christiani Wagner et Catharina Conj. Friderici Kyttner, et Antonius Lux, o[mn]es Petersd[orffio].

entries.subject: Theresia
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Maria Conjux Christophori Reynelt; Testes Maria Conj. Joannis Urba, Joannes Kyttner
entries.transcription: Petroviciô | 5 | Baptizata est Theresia filia Georgij Hoffman et Clarae Conjugis ejus. Levans Maria Conjux Christophori Reynelt. Testes Maria Conj. Joannis Urba et Joannes Kyttner omnes Petroviciô.
entries.notes: První zápis na straně pag. 231 navazující na měsíc květen ('Mense Majô') z konce pag. 230.

entries.subject: Anna Theresia
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Rosina filia post def. Georgium Henrich; Testes Susanna filia post def. Christianum Lux, Josephus Scholtz der büsenmüller
entries.transcription: Petersdorffio | 4 | Baptizata est Anna Theresia filia Josephi Ulrich et Catharinae Conjugis ejus. Levans Rosina filia post def. Georgium Henrich. Testes: Susanna filia post def. Christianum Lux, et Josephus Scholtz der büsenmüller omnes Petersd:

entries.subject: Margaretha Maria
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Maria Conjux Christiani Herman; Testes Regina Conjux Christophori Wagner, Fridericus Kyttner
entries.transcription: Petersdorffi[o] | 14 | Baptizata est Margaretha Maria filia Caspari Wagner et Rosinae Conjugis ejus. Levans: Maria Conjux Christiani Herman. Testes: Regina Conjux Christophori Wagner et Fridericus Kyttner omnes Petersd.

entries.subject: Joannes Wenceslaus
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Joannes Bayer; Testes Christophorus Esler, Maria Conjux Christiani Herman
entries.transcription: Petersdorfio | 28 | Baptizatus est Joannes Wenceslaus filius Petri Scholtz et Annae M[ariae] Conjugis ejus. Levans: Joannes Bayer. Testes Christophorus Esler et Maria Conjux Christiani Herman omnes Petersdorffiô.

entries.subject: Ignatius Antonius
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Christianus Lux; Testes Joannis Bayer uxor Anna Maria, Catharina Vidua post def. Salomonem Schoen
entries.transcription: Petersdorffi[o] | 31 | Baptizatus est Ignatius Antonius filius Josephi Schroller et Annae Mariae Conjugis ejus. Levans: Christianus Lux. Testes: Joannis Bayer uxor Anna Maria et Catharina Vidua post def. Salomonem Schoen omnes Petersdorffiô.

entries.subject: Ignatius Antonius
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Casparus Schmok; Testes Joseph Scholtz Büsenmüller, Birgitta Conjux Josephi Schroller Aeditui
entries.role: molitor (büsenmüller, svědek); aedituus (manžel svědkyně, Josephus Schroller)
entries.transcription: Petersdorff[io] | 31 | Baptizatus est Ignatius Antonius filius Antonij Bayer et Mariae Conjugis ejus. Levans: Casparus Schmok Testes Joseph Scholtz Büsenmüller et Birgitta Conjux Josephi Schroller Aeditui omnes reliq. Petersdorffiô.
entries.notes: První přímý doklad funkce kostelníka ('Aeditui', tj. u nového kostela sv. Petra a Pavla dostavěného r. 1734) u Josefa Schrollera, manžela svědkyně Brigity.

entries.subject: Clara Theresia
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Birgitta Conjux Josephi Schroller fabri; Testes Elisabeth Conjux Antonij Lux, Anna M[a]ria Conj. Christiani Wagner, Susanna Conj. Caspari Pacha, M[a]ria Vid. p. def. Christian[um] Herman, Georg Adam Exner ex Rothflösl
entries.transcription: Petersdorff[io] | 12 | Baptizata est Clara Theresia filia Michaëlis Epel et Annae M[a]riae Conjugis ejus. Levans Birgitta Conjux Josephi Schroller fabri. Testes: Elisabeth Conjux Antonij Lux et Anna M[a]ria Conj. Christiani Wagner et Susanna Conj. Caspari Pacha et M[a]ria Vid. p. def. Christian[um] Herman et Georg Adam Exner ex Rothflösl reliqui Petersdorffi.
entries.notes: Kmotra Brigita zde uvedena jako manželka Josefa Schrollera, kováře ('fabri').

entries.subject: Joannes Franciscus
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Joannes Kyttner; Testes Christianus Wagner, Anna Maria Conjux Christophori Epel
entries.transcription: Petersdorffio | 14 | Baptizatus est Joannes Franciscus filius Christiani Lux Senioris, et Elisabethae Conjugis ejus. Levans: Joannes Kyttner. Testes: Christianus Wagner, et Anna Maria Conjux Christophori Epel omnes Petersd.

entries.subject: Kilianus
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Petrus Scholtz; Testes Casparus Pacha, Maria Conjux Christiani Wagner
entries.transcription: Petersdorffio | 24 | Baptizatus est Kilianus filius Andreae Urba et Barbarae Conjugis ejus. Levans: Petrus Scholtz Testes: Casparus Pacha et Maria Conjux Christiani Wagner omnes Petersd.

entries.subject: Anna
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Rosina Conjux Caspari Wagner; Testes Anna Conjux Zachariae Schroller, Christianus Lux
entries.transcription: Petersdorfiô | 6 | Baptizata est Anna filia Joannis Friderici Henrich et Susannae Conjugis ejus. Levans: Rosina Conjux Caspari Wagner. Testes: Anna Conjux Zachariae Schroller. et Christianus Lux omnes Petersdorfiô. Baptizavit ARD. Joseph Hördler Curatus Wixstadj.
entries.notes: První výskyt nového mladkovského kuráta Josefa Hördlera.

entries.subject: Anna Eleonora
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Eleonora Conjux Antonij Sstiepan; Testes Susanna Conjux Caspari Pacha, Josephus Lux
entries.transcription: Petersdorfiô | 9 | Baptizata est Anna Eleonora filia Josephi Peschke et Elisabethae Conjugis ejus. Levans: Eleonora Conjux Antonij Sstiepan. Testes Susanna Conjux Caspari Pacha, et Josephus Lux omnes Petroviciô.

entries.subject: Theresia
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Rosina Conjux Caspari Wagner; Testes Catharina Vidua post def. Salomonem Schoen, Petrus Volkner
entries.transcription: Petersdorffiô | eod | Baptizata est Theresia filia Christophori Esler des müttlers. et Mariae Conjugis ejus. Levans: Rosina Conjux Caspari Wagner. Testes: Catharina Vidua post def. Salomonem Schoen et Petrus Volkner omnes Petersd.
entries.notes: Otec Christophorus Esler s přízviskem či označením 'des müttlers.' (možná prostřední / Mittler / Müttler).

entries.subject: Theresia
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Elisabetha Conjux Antonij Luchs; Testes Anna Conjux Zachariae Schroller, Josephus Luchs
entries.transcription: Petersdorfiô | 13 | Baptizata est Theresia filia Josephi Urban et Elisabethae Conjugis ejus. Levans: Elisabetha Conjux Antonij Luchs. Testes: Anna Conjux Zachariae Schroller, et Josephus Luchs omnes Petersdorfiô.

entries.subject: Anna Rosina
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Rosina filia post def. Salomonem Schoen; Testes Susanna Conjux Christiani Luchs, Joannes Kittner
entries.transcription: Petersdorffiô | eod | Baptizata est Anna Rosina filia Mathiae Adler et Rosinae Conjugis ejus. Levans: Rosina filia post def. Salomonem Schoen. Testes Susanna Conjux Christiani Luchs et Joannes Kittner omnes Petersdorffiô.

entries.subject: Anna Maria
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Rosina Conjux Caspari Wagner; Testes Anna Conjux Zachariae Schroller, Petrus Scholtz
entries.transcription: Petersdorffio | 30 | Baptizata est Anna Maria filia Joannis Klaper et Elisabethae Conjugis ejus. Levans: Rosina Conjux Caspari Wagner. Testes: Anna Conjux Zachariae Schroller et Petrus Scholtz omnes Petersd. Baptizavit ARD. Hördler Curat. Wixstadj.

entries.subject: Anna Maria Francisca Josepha Theresia
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Francisca filia D. Francisci Friemel pt. Burggraf. Mittelwald.; Testes Anna Maria Petri Scholtzin Conj. Mittelwal:, Caspar Schmok Petersd.
entries.role: teloniarius (otec, p.t. teloniarij Petersd.); burggrafius (otec kmotry v Mittelwalde)
entries.transcription: Petersdorffiô | Eod | Baptizata est Anna Maria Francisca Josepha Theresia filia Antonij Seiffert pt. Teloniarij Petersd. et Gertrudis Conj. ejus. Levans: Francisca filia D. Francisci Friemel pt. Burggraf. Mittelwad. Testes: Anna Maria [nad řádkem: Petri] Scholtzin [nad řádkem: Conj.] Mittelwal: et Caspar Schmok Petersd. o[mn]es: Baptizavit ARD. Hördler pt. Curat Wixstadj.
entries.notes: Datum 'Eod' navazuje na předchozí zápis z 10. 1. 1736 (Nekorziô). První doložený výskyt nového celníka v Českých Petrovicích Antonína Seifferta ('pt. Teloniarij Petersd.'). Kmotra z rodiny purkrabího z Mezilesí (Mittelwalde) a svědkyně manželka Petra Scholtze z Mezilesí.

entries.subject: Anna Margaretha
entries.godparents_or_witnesses: Levans Susanna Conjux Joannis Steiner; Testes Susanna Conjux Caspari Adler, Christophorus Esler
entries.priest: ARD. Franc. Wiesner pt. Altarista Geybgsi.
entries.transcription: Petersdorfiô | 17 | Baptizata est Anna Margaretha filia Joannis Postler et Mariae Conjugis ejus. Levans: Susanna Conjux Joannis Steiner. Testes: Susanna Conjux Caspari Adler et Christophorus Esler omnes Petersdorfiô. Baptizavit ARD. Franc. Wiesner pt. Altarista Geybgsi.
entries.notes: Křtil kyšperský altarista František Wiesner ('Altarista Geybgsi.').

entries.subject: Florianus
